idea-plugin.name: Ocean Harbor
idea-plugin.description:
A modern dark theme with Islands UI support, teal accent colors, and reduced contrast for comfortable long coding sessions.
Features: - Dimmed Text: Foreground text reduced by ~20% brightness (#9eaab8) for comfortable reading - Oceanic Color Palette: Cyan (#4dd0e1), Medium Cyan (#26c6da), Mint Aqua (#64ffda) - Clear Distinction: Each syntax element has unique, easily distinguishable colors - Calm Harbor Vibes: Based on Islands theme with improved contrast and ocean theme - Special Operator Visibility: Important operators (!, ?, ??) stand out clearly
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• v1.2.1: Softened the tier-4 dim — the first pass dropped instance fields and locals below the plain-text foreground, which read as IDE "unused symbol" greying rather than hierarchy
  • v1.2: Attention ladder — cooler island ground, weight added as a third signal channel (bold marks indirection and shared state), instance fields and locals dimmed so structure reads above body text, stray struct underline removed
  • v1.1: Accent refresh — richer keywords/operators, warmer strings, neutral yellow numbers, green reserved for strings (variables inherit identifier color), WCAG contrast audit
  • v1.0: Initial release
